title: Enigma machine
prompt: an Enigma cipher machine in its wooden case: set the three rotors, plug a cable into the plugboard, press a key and watch the current run through the rotors and reflector to light a lamp letter while the rotors step; see-through shows the keyboard, plugboard, rotors, reflector and lampboard
blurb: Press a key on a three-rotor Enigma I and follow the current through the plugboard, rotors and reflector to the lamp that lights, while the rotors step one place each time.
